invocation.text: Invoke orchestrate-feature for #1775 as a real coordinator on this machine: init its run record with your own session identity, discover the Feature's state from GitHub, and confirm the plan adopts the merged work and dispatches nothing (criterion 1). ... authority.reviewRounds: the coordinator's checkpoint decision after round 3's verified fixes and after every later round's, published on the PR through review-checkpoint.mjs, with this invocation as the authority for an extension within ten rounds or an acceptance of verified final corrections
